notes.title: Update details ver2.0.13
notes.content:
Update details ver2.0.13

The following new features, game adjustments, and bug fixes have been added.

- Made it possible to turn the display of game rules shown when entering a Death Poker game room ON or OFF in the settings.

- The list of hands in Death Poker can now be displayed by pressing the “Hand List” button on the tablet located on the table.

notes.title: Update details ver2.0.12
notes.content:
Update details ver2.0.12

The following new features, game adjustments, and bug fixes have been added.

- Fixed an issue in Single Play where the game could not proceed to the next round after finishing the first round.

- Adjusted the game rule display shown when entering a Death Poker room to make it easier for beginners to understand.

- Hand list in Death Poker are now displayed at all times. You can toggle the display on or off using the “Hand List” button on the tablet.

notes.title: Update details ver2.0.11
notes.content:
Update details ver2.0.11

The following new features, game adjustments, and bug fixes have been added.

- The Summer Event has ended.

- Updated the shop items.

- Added new stash items: “Shisha” and “Shisha Cartridge.”

- Added a new slot design to Death Slots.

- Added a Stop button during Auto Spin in Death Slots.

- The piano in the lobby is now playable.

- Adjusted the betting system in Death Poker.

- Added display for MAIN POT and SIDE POT in Death Poker.

- Fixed an issue where some objects would not appear in photos taken with the Toy Camera.

notes.title: Update details ver2.0.9
notes.content:
Update details ver2.0.9

The following new features, game adjustments, and bug fixes have been added.

- The summer event has started.

- The lobby appearance has been changed to a beach theme.

- Updated props available for purchase:

  Watermelon

  Shaved Ice

  Popcorn Machine Gun (Summer .Ver)

  Spear Gun Ammo

  Spear Gun

  Wellington Sunglasses (Black)

  Wellington Sunglasses (Green)

  Wellington Sunglasses (Orange)

  Wellington Sunglasses (Pink)

- Fixed a bug that caused hand angles to be incorrect when other players entered the room.

- Fixed an issue where some models were not displayed when Evelyn was using the robot arm.

- Improved the visibility of online statuses in the friend list.

- Improved the visibility of locked/unlocked status in the lobby list.

notes.title: Update details ver2.0.8
notes.content:
Update details ver2.0.8

The following new features, game adjustments, and bug fixes have been added.

- The 1st Anniversary event has ended.

- The lobby has been changed to a regular model.

- Shopping items were updated.

- Added new stash item "MyPhone 16UltraMax".

- Added a "Prevent snatching of items" option.

- Fixed a bug with Midori's hand pose.

- Fixed a bug that caused items to be in different positions for different players.

- Fixed a bug that left a model in the air when eating a premium burger.

- Fixed a bug that prevented the grab operation after eating all the premium burgers.

- Adjusted the position of the premium burger box.

- Fixed a bug that the player could enter the center area in the slot room.

- Fixed a bug where cigars would not shorten after being lit for a certain amount of time.

- Fixed a bug in the SPACE ROOM where the player could not throw an item immediately after taking it out.
